ValidationRule.description: Restricts the "Forecast Pending" forecast status to Practice Intelligence / Lexology Intelligence teams (and a designated user); blocks other owner teams from selecting it.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Opportunity_Owner_Team__c <> 'Lexology Pro', Opportunity_Owner_Team__c <> 'Specialist Platforms', Opportunity_Owner_Team__c <> 'Lexology Intelligence', Opportunity_Owner_Team__c <> 'Lexology Academic', OwnerId <> '0056g000005rqzu', text(Forecast_Status__c) = 'Forecast Pending')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Forecast Pending is used only by PI and Intelligence team
